name: Metals & Mining Momentum Breakout
description: Momentum breakout strategy for metals and mining stocks (AA, CENX, NUE, STLD, FCX, SCCO, X, CLF, RS). Entry: close breaks above prior bar's 60-day Donchian upper band. Exit: close breaks below prior bar's 20-day Donchian lower band. Position sizing: 10% equal weight per signal. Long-only. Includes a cross-sectional cost breakdown table estimating total commission ($1/fill flat fee), slippage (10 bps/fill), and total costs per asset, plus roundtrip trade count.
source:
# Metals & Mining Momentum Breakout
# =============================================================================
# Trend-following breakout strategy on metals and mining stocks:
# AA, CENX, NUE, STLD, FCX, SCCO, X, CLF, RS
#
# RULES:
# - Entry: Close > Prior bar's 60-day Donchian Upper Band (highest high)
# - Exit:  Close < Prior bar's 20-day Donchian Lower Band (lowest low)
# - Sizing: 10% of equity per position (equal weight)
# - Long-only strategy
# =============================================================================

# =============================================================================
# DATA SOURCE
# =============================================================================
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c
high = src.h
low = src.l

# =============================================================================
# INDICATORS
# =============================================================================

# 60-Day Donchian Channel for ENTRY (highest high over 60 days)
donchian_entry = donchian_channel(window=60)(high, low)
upper_band_60 = donchian_entry.donchian_upper

# 20-Day Donchian Channel for EXIT (lowest low over 20 days)
donchian_exit = donchian_channel(window=20)(high, low)
lower_band_20 = donchian_exit.donchian_lower

# Lag bands by 1 bar to avoid look-ahead bias
# Today's high/low contributes to today's channel — compare against PRIOR bar
upper_60_prior = upper_band_60 >> 1
lower_20_prior = lower_band_20 >> 1

# =============================================================================
# ENTRY / EXIT SIGNALS
# =============================================================================

# ENTRY: Close breaks above prior bar's 60-day high (new breakout)
entry_signal = close > upper_60_prior

# EXIT: Close breaks below prior bar's 20-day low (trend breakdown)
exit_signal = close < lower_20_prior

# Hold position from entry breakout until exit breakdown fires
held = hold_until()(enter=entry_signal, exit=exit_signal)

# =============================================================================
# EXECUTION
# =============================================================================

# Long-only zone
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=held)

# Equal-weight position sizing: 10% of equity per position
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=10)

# =============================================================================
# EVENT MARKERS
# =============================================================================

# Mark breakout entries (60-day high breakout)
event_marker(schema=EventMarkerSchema(
    title="60-Day Breakout Entry",
    icon=Icon.TrendingUpIcon,
    schemas=[
        ColumnSpec(title="Close", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(title="Breakout Level", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(title="Signal", type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
    ]
))(close, upper_60_prior, entry_signal)

# Mark breakdown exits (20-day low breakdown)
event_marker(schema=EventMarkerSchema(
    title="20-Day Breakdown Exit",
    icon=Icon.TrendingDownIcon,
    schemas=[
        ColumnSpec(title="Close", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(title="Breakdown Level", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(title="Signal", type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
    ]
))(close, lower_20_prior, exit_signal)

# =============================================================================
# COST BREAKDOWN (Cross-Sectional Summary Table)
# =============================================================================
# Detect new roundtrip entries and exits from the held state transitions.
# A new entry occurs when 'held' transitions from False/null to True.
# A new exit occurs when 'held' transitions from True to False.
# Cost estimates use assumed rates:
#   - Commission: $1.00 per fill (flat fee), 2 fills per roundtrip
#   - Slippage: 10 bps per fill on close price, 2 fills per roundtrip
# NOTE: These are estimates. Actual costs depend on your configured
# commission/slippage models and the execution engine's fill prices.

prev_held = coalesce(held >> 1, False)
new_entry = held and not prev_held
new_exit = prev_held and not held

# Trade count: 1 per new entry (each entry starts a roundtrip)
trade_marker = where(new_entry, 1)

# Estimated commission: $1/fill × 2 fills = $2 per roundtrip (charged at entry)
est_commission = where(new_entry, 2.0)

# Estimated slippage: 10 bps/fill × 2 fills × close at entry (per-share estimate)
est_slippage = where(new_entry, close * 0.002)

# Estimated total cost per roundtrip (per-share)
est_total = where(new_entry, 2.0 + close * 0.002)

# Cross-sectional table: one row per asset, summed over time
cs_summary_table(
    title="Estimated Cost Breakdown by Asset",
    category="Cost Analysis",
    agg=AggregationType.Sum,
    schema=TableReportSchema(
        columns=[
            ColumnSpec(title="Roundtrip Trades", type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(title="Est. Commission ($)", type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="Est. Slippage ($)", type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="Est. Total Cost ($)", type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    )
)(trade_marker, est_commission, est_slippage, est_total)
